subject: physics
question_text: The roof of the buildings are often painted white during summer. Why?

verification.note: Asked in TS Inter I-Year Physics Paper-I, March 2017 (Q7) — Section A, 2 marks. The 1 + 1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it; the question itself is sourced from that paper. Physics hand-checked: a white surface has low absorptance and high reflectance for solar radiation, so it takes in less energy and reaches a lower temperature than a black surface in the same sunlight.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: White reflects radiation
lines: A white surface reflects most of the
radiation that falls on it and absorbs
A black surface would absorb almost all
steps.margin_note: First mark. Say that white is a good reflector and a poor absorber.
steps.why: The colour of a surface determines how much of the radiation falling on it is absorbed and how much is sent back, and white reflects across the whole visible range.
common_mistakes: Saying white paint works because it is a poor conductor. The reason is reflection, not conduction.

recall.must_convey: That a white surface reflects most of the radiation and absorbs very little.

steps.memory_tip: White reflects, black absorbs. That is the whole reason for the paint.

steps.label: The rooms stay cooler
lines: So a white roof takes in less heat from
the Sun during the day, and the rooms
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Connect the reflection to the cooler room below.
steps.why: A roof that absorbs less radiation reaches a lower temperature, so less heat is conducted down through it into the rooms.
common_mistakes: Stopping at the words white is cool. The answer must say that less radiation is absorbed.

recall.must_convey: That less heat is absorbed, so the rooms below the roof stay cooler.
accept: roof stays at a lower temperature

steps.memory_tip: Less absorbed means less heat entering, so the rooms below stay cooler.

insider_note: Two marks, two steps — white reflects, therefore less heat enters. An answer that names the colour but not the reflection earns one mark.
